questions.q: If # = ×, @ = -, $ = +, then evaluate: 9 # 2 @ 3 $ 1
questions.s:
Given Equation: 9 # 2 @ 3 $ 1 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

Decoding the given information:

Symbol # @ $
Meaning × − +

⇒ 9 × 2 - 3 + 1

⇒ 18 - 3 + 1

⇒ 19 - 3

⇒ 16

Hence, the correct option is "Option 3".

questions.s:
Answer is 118.
Dekh bhai... Negative remainder ka basic hack. Divisor aur Remainder ke beech ka difference check kar: $6-4=2$, $8-6=2$, $10-8=2$. Sabme common negative offset -2 aa raha hai. questions.q: Q17. Which of the following best distinguishes glacial till from water-laid glacial sediments? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन हिमनद टिल (glacial till) को जल-जमा हिमनद तलछट (water-laid glacial sediments) से सबसे अच्छी तरह अलग करता है? [SSC CGL Tier 1, 15 Sep 2025, Shift-3]
o: It is layered and stratified due to flowing meltwater. / बहते पिघले पानी के कारण यह स्तरित (layered) और स्तरीकृत (stratified) है।
It is composed of uniformly sized, rounded particles. / यह समान आकार के, गोल कणों से बना है।
It forms only in glacial lakes / यह केवल हिमनद झीलों में बनता है
It is an unsorted mix of materials deposited directly by ice  / यह सीधे बर्फ द्वारा जमा की गई सामग्रियों का बिना छंटा हुआ (unsorted) मिश्रण है
questions.s: True Glacial till is definitively characterized as a completely "unsorted" and utterly "unstratified" mass of rough sediment aggressively deposited directly by melting solid ice. Because colossal moving ice can effortlessly carry massive heavy boulders and microscopic flour-sized clay simultaneously without any separation, till is always a highly chaotic, unsorted mix of absolutely all sizes. / वास्तविक हिमनद टिल (Glacial till) को निश्चित रूप से पिघलती ठोस बर्फ द्वारा सीधे आक्रामक रूप से जमा किए गए खुरदरे तलछट के पूरी तरह से "बिना छंटे" (unsorted) और पूरी तरह से "अस्तरीकृत" द्रव्यमान के रूप में पहचाना जाता है। क्योंकि विशाल गतिमान बर्फ आसानी से बड़े भारी पत्थरों और सूक्ष्म आटे के आकार की मिट्टी को बिना किसी अलगाव के एक साथ ले जा सकती है, टिल हमेशा बिल्कुल सभी आकारों का एक अत्यधिक अराजक, बिना छंटा हुआ मिश्रण होता है।

questions.q: In a test, Arjun was asked to calculate the mean proportional of 20 and 320. What is the correct answer that Arjun should give?
questions.s:
Given:

Numbers = 20 and 320

Concept Used:

Mean proportional = (ab)1/2

Calculation:

⇒ Mean proportional of 20 and 320 = $\sqrt{20\times 320}$

⇒ Mean proportional of 20 and 320 = $\sqrt{6400}$ = 80

Therefore, the correct answer that Arjun should give is 80.

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Perfidious
questions.s:
The correct answer is: Loyal.

Key Points

  • The word "Perfidious" means deceitful and untrustworthy; someone who deliberately betrays trust or behaves dishonestly. (धोखेबाज)
    • Example: He was accused of being perfidious when he revealed confidential information to the enemy.
  • "Loyal" refers to someone who is faithful, devoted, and trustworthy, showing unwavering support and allegiance. (वफादार)
    • Example: She has always been loyal to her friends, standing by them during tough times.
  • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'Perfidious' is 'Loyal'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Loyal.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Betraying (धोखा देना): Act of being disloyal or breaking trust.
    • Example: Betraying someone's trust can lead to irreparable damage to relationships.
  • Faithless (अविश्वासी): Lacking loyalty or trustworthiness.
    • Example: The faithless soldier deserted his post during the battle.
  • Treacherous (धोखेबाज): Guilty of betrayal or deception; dangerous and unreliable.
    • Example: The treacherous path through the mountains was fraught with danger.

questions.q: A salesman is allowed $16.66\%$ commission on the total sales made by him and a bonus of $3.33\%$ on the sales over $Rs$ $18000$. If the total earning of the salesman is $Rs$ $9720$. Find the total sales?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, 'Shift Method' lagayenge isme, bina X maane! Commission $16.66\%$ (yani 1/6) aur bonus $3.33\%$ (yani 1/30). Total $20\%$. Agar shuru ke $18000$ par bhi usko $3.33\%$ bonus milta, toh uski kamai kitni badh jati? $18000 \times 3.33\% = 600$ badh jati. Nayi total kamai = $9720 + 600 = 10320$. Ye $10320$ total sales ka $20\%$ (1/5) hai. Total sales = $10320 \times 5 = 51600$. Ye trick sabse best hai!

questions.q: Q7. Which of the following is an erosional landform created primarily by river action? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मुख्य रूप से नदी की क्रिया द्वारा निर्मित एक अपरदनात्मक भू-आकृति (erosional landform) है? [Ssc Steno 2025, 07/08/2025, Shift-3]
questions.s: A Gorge is an incredibly deep, extremely narrow valley characterized by nearly vertical, very steep sides, formed predominantly by the intense vertical erosional activity of a fast-flowing river, typically found in its highly energetic upper course where aggressive down-cutting completely dominates. Deltas and levees are strictly depositional, and moraines are exclusively formed by moving glaciers. / एक गॉर्ज (Gorge) एक अविश्वसनीय रूप से गहरी, अत्यंत संकरी घाटी है जिसकी विशेषता लगभग ऊर्ध्वाधर, बहुत खड़ी भुजाएँ हैं, जो मुख्य रूप से एक तेज बहने वाली नदी की तीव्र ऊर्ध्वाधर अपरदनात्मक गतिविधि से बनती हैं, जो आमतौर पर इसके अत्यधिक ऊर्जावान ऊपरी मार्ग में पाई जाती हैं जहाँ आक्रामक डाउन-कटिंग पूरी तरह से हावी होती है। डेल्टा और लेवी कड़ाई से निक्षेपात्मक (depositional) हैं, और मोराइन विशेष रूप से चलती ग्लेशियरों द्वारा बनते हैं।

questions_hin.q_hi: Q17. Which of the following best distinguishes glacial till from water-laid glacial sediments? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन हिमनद टिल (glacial till) को जल-जमा हिमनद तलछट (water-laid glacial sediments) से सबसे अच्छी तरह अलग करता है? [SSC CGL Tier 1, 15 Sep 2025, Shift-3]
o_hi: It is layered and stratified due to flowing meltwater. / बहते पिघले पानी के कारण यह स्तरित (layered) और स्तरीकृत (stratified) है।
It is composed of uniformly sized, rounded particles. / यह समान आकार के, गोल कणों से बना है।
It forms only in glacial lakes / यह केवल हिमनद झीलों में बनता है
It is an unsorted mix of materials deposited directly by ice  / यह सीधे बर्फ द्वारा जमा की गई सामग्रियों का बिना छंटा हुआ (unsorted) मिश्रण है
questions_hin.s_hi: True Glacial till is definitively characterized as a completely "unsorted" and utterly "unstratified" mass of rough sediment aggressively deposited directly by melting solid ice. Because colossal moving ice can effortlessly carry massive heavy boulders and microscopic flour-sized clay simultaneously without any separation, till is always a highly chaotic, unsorted mix of absolutely all sizes. / वास्तविक हिमनद टिल (Glacial till) को निश्चित रूप से पिघलती ठोस बर्फ द्वारा सीधे आक्रामक रूप से जमा किए गए खुरदरे तलछट के पूरी तरह से "बिना छंटे" (unsorted) और पूरी तरह से "अस्तरीकृत" द्रव्यमान के रूप में पहचाना जाता है। क्योंकि विशाल गतिमान बर्फ आसानी से बड़े भारी पत्थरों और सूक्ष्म आटे के आकार की मिट्टी को बिना किसी अलगाव के एक साथ ले जा सकती है, टिल हमेशा बिल्कुल सभी आकारों का एक अत्यधिक अराजक, बिना छंटा हुआ मिश्रण होता है।

questions_hin.q_hi: In a test, Arjun was asked to calculate the mean proportional of 20 and 320. What is the correct answer that Arjun should give?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Given:

Numbers = 20 and 320

Concept Used:

Mean proportional = (ab)1/2

Calculation:

⇒ Mean proportional of 20 and 320 = $\sqrt{20\times 320}$

⇒ Mean proportional of 20 and 320 = $\sqrt{6400}$ = 80

Therefore, the correct answer that Arjun should give is 80.

questions_hin.q_hi:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Perfidious
questions_hin.s_hi:
The correct answer is: Loyal.

Key Points

  • The word "Perfidious" means deceitful and untrustworthy; someone who deliberately betrays trust or behaves dishonestly. (धोखेबाज)
    • Example: He was accused of being perfidious when he revealed confidential information to the enemy.
  • "Loyal" refers to someone who is faithful, devoted, and trustworthy, showing unwavering support and allegiance. (वफादार)
    • Example: She has always been loyal to her friends, standing by them during tough times.
  • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'Perfidious' is 'Loyal'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Loyal.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Betraying (धोखा देना): Act of being disloyal or breaking trust.
    • Example: Betraying someone's trust can lead to irreparable damage to relationships.
  • Faithless (अविश्वासी): Lacking loyalty or trustworthiness.
    • Example: The faithless soldier deserted his post during the battle.
  • Treacherous (धोखेबाज): Guilty of betrayal or deception; dangerous and unreliable.
    • Example: The treacherous path through the mountains was fraught with danger.

questions_hin.q_hi: A salesman is allowed $16.66\%$ commission on the total sales made by him and a bonus of $3.33\%$ on the sales over $Rs$ $18000$. If the total earning of the salesman is $Rs$ $9720$. Find the total sales?
questions_hin.s_hi: Dekh bhai, 'Shift Method' lagayenge isme, bina X maane! Commission $16.66\%$ (yani 1/6) aur bonus $3.33\%$ (yani 1/30). Total $20\%$. Agar shuru ke $18000$ par bhi usko $3.33\%$ bonus milta, toh uski kamai kitni badh jati? $18000 \times 3.33\% = 600$ badh jati. Nayi total kamai = $9720 + 600 = 10320$. Ye $10320$ total sales ka $20\%$ (1/5) hai. Total sales = $10320 \times 5 = 51600$. Ye trick sabse best hai!

questions_hin.q_hi: Q7. Which of the following is an erosional landform created primarily by river action? / निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मुख्य रूप से नदी की क्रिया द्वारा निर्मित एक अपरदनात्मक भू-आकृति (erosional landform) है? [Ssc Steno 2025, 07/08/2025, Shift-3]
questions_hin.s_hi: A Gorge is an incredibly deep, extremely narrow valley characterized by nearly vertical, very steep sides, formed predominantly by the intense vertical erosional activity of a fast-flowing river, typically found in its highly energetic upper course where aggressive down-cutting completely dominates. Deltas and levees are strictly depositional, and moraines are exclusively formed by moving glaciers. / एक गॉर्ज (Gorge) एक अविश्वसनीय रूप से गहरी, अत्यंत संकरी घाटी है जिसकी विशेषता लगभग ऊर्ध्वाधर, बहुत खड़ी भुजाएँ हैं, जो मुख्य रूप से एक तेज बहने वाली नदी की तीव्र ऊर्ध्वाधर अपरदनात्मक गतिविधि से बनती हैं, जो आमतौर पर इसके अत्यधिक ऊर्जावान ऊपरी मार्ग में पाई जाती हैं जहाँ आक्रामक डाउन-कटिंग पूरी तरह से हावी होती है। डेल्टा और लेवी कड़ाई से निक्षेपात्मक (depositional) हैं, और मोराइन विशेष रूप से चलती ग्लेशियरों द्वारा बनते हैं।
